clause_diff.summary: [new_duty] The amendment to clause 18 adds or changes a duty. Added: "The bank shall inform the applicant in writing of the reason(s) for rejection within seven working days.".
clause_diff.before: 18. The Customer Acceptance Policy shall not result in denial of a banking / financial facility to members of the general public, especially those who are financially or socially disadvantaged, including the Persons with Disabilities (PwDs). The bank shall not reject an application for onboarding or periodic updation of KYC without application of mind. The officer concerned shall duly record the reason(s) for rejection.
clause_diff.after: 18. The Customer Acceptance Policy shall not result in denial of a banking / financial facility to members of the general public, especially those who are financially or socially disadvantaged, including the Persons with Disabilities (PwDs). The bank shall not reject an application for onboarding or periodic updation of KYC without application of mind. The officer concerned shall duly record the reason(s) for rejection. The bank shall inform the applicant in writing of the reason(s) for rejection within seven working days.

C9 provides more frequent reminders but does not specify the seven working day threshold.
